source.other: Build a tavern to produce some food to sustain our miners.

target.other: Bygg en krog för att producera mat så att våra gruvarbetare orkar arbeta.

key: Build a tavern to produce some food to sustain our miners.

source.other: A Message

target.other: Ett meddelande

key: A Message

source.other: I beg you to be cautious and to build some blockhouses or sentries around our colony.

target.other: Jag ber dig att vi ska vara försiktiga och bygga några blockhus och vaktposter runt vår koloni.

key: I beg you to be cautious and to build some blockhouses or sentries around our colony.

source.other: Diary of Lutius

target.other: Lutius dagbok

key: Diary of Lutius

source.other: Protect your colony

target.other: Skydda din koloni

key: Protect your colony

source.other: However: for all these bigger buildings, we need better and more elegant building materials. So you have to build a house for the stonemason, who will cut columns from marble.

target.other: Men för alla dessa större byggnader behöver vi bättre och mer eleganta byggnadsmaterial. Därför behöver du bygga ett stenhuggeri där pelare kan huggas ut ur marmor.

key: However: for all these bigger buildings, we need better and more elegant building materials. So you have to build a house for the stonemason, who will cut columns from marble.

source.other: Stonemason’s house and Mining Infrastructure

target.other: Stenhuggeri och gruvinfrastruktur

key: Stonemason’s house and Mining Infrastructure

source.other: Build three lumberjack’s houses, a forester’s house and a sawmill.

target.other: Bygg tre skogshuggarbostäder, ett skogsvaktarboställe och ett sågverk.

key: Build three lumberjack’s houses, a forester’s house and a sawmill.

source.other: Wood for the Colony

target.other: Timmer till kolonin

key: Wood for the Colony

source.other: 7 days later…

target.other: 7 dagar senare…

key: 7 days later…

source.other: Further Mountains

target.other: Fler berg

key: Further Mountains

source.other: Build stronger military buildings, such as an outpost, a barrier or a tower, on the eastern frontier.

target.other: Bygg starkare militärbyggnader, som en utpost, ett fort eller ett torn, vid den östra gränsen.

key: Build stronger military buildings, such as an outpost, a barrier or a tower, on the eastern frontier.

source.other: But until that day, many years may pass! For now, we must concentrate on the present, and build a few lumberjack’s houses and a sawmill to produce some basic building materials.

target.other: Men innan den dagen kommer kan det gå många år! För stunden måste vi koncentrera oss på nutiden och bygga några skogshuggarbostäder och ett sågverk för att producera grundläggande byggnadsmaterial.

key: But until that day, many years may pass! For now, we must concentrate on the present, and build a few lumberjack’s houses and a sawmill to produce some basic building materials.

source.other: Food for the Miners

target.other: Mat åt gruvarbetarna

key: Food for the Miners

source.other: On this island, we will start our new life. We will build up an outpost for our exile, which perhaps will become a new, beautiful home for every one of us.

target.other: På denna ö ska vi starta vårt nya liv. Vi ska bygga en utpost för vår landsflykt, som kanske kommer att bli ett nytt, vackert hem för oss alla.

key: On this island, we will start our new life. We will build up an outpost for our exile, which perhaps will become a new, beautiful home for every one of us.

source.other: Saledus looks unhappy

target.other: Saledus ser olycklig ut

key: Saledus looks unhappy

source.other: Build a stonemason’s house and then a complete mining and production infrastructure (coal mine and / or charcoal kiln, iron mine, toolsmithy, weapon smithy, armor smithy and smelting works).

target.other: Bygg ett stenhuggeri och komplettera sedan infrastrukturen för gruvdrift och produktion (kolgruva och/eller kolmila, järngruva, verktygssmedja, vapensmedja, rustningssmedja och smältverk).

key: Build a stonemason’s house and then a complete mining and production infrastructure (coal mine and / or charcoal kiln, iron mine, toolsmithy, weapon smithy, armor smithy and smelting works).

source.other: It is good to see that we have now got a warmer and more familiar environment on our island. Thank you, Lutius.

target.other: Det är skönt att se att vi nu har fått en varmare och mer vänskaplig miljö här på ön. Tack, Lutius.

key: It is good to see that we have now got a warmer and more familiar environment on our island. Thank you, Lutius.

source.other: Protect Your Colony

target.other: Skydda din koloni

key: Protect Your Colony

source.other: Finally! This island appears to have been made for us, it is a gift from the Gods to my people and myself. Until now, we have only seen a small part of this island, but this part alone is already bringing sunlight to my mind. I feel as if we have found a priceless treasure, a land like paradise.

target.other: Äntligen! Den här ön verkar vara som gjord för oss, den är en gåva från gudarna till mig och mitt folk. Fram tills nu har vi bara sett en liten del av ön, men bara det vi har sett ger mig sol i sinnet. Det känns som om vi har hittat en ovärderlig skatt, ett paradisland.

key: Finally! This island appears to have been made for us, it is a gift from the Gods to my people and myself. Until now, we have only seen a small part of this island, but this part alone is already bringing sunlight to my mind. I feel as if we have found a priceless treasure, a land like paradise.

source.other: Today a pigeon landed on our island. It brought a message which fills me with dark thoughts and brings back my fears.

target.other: Idag landade en duva på vår ö. Den hade med sig ett meddelande som fyller mitt sinne med mörka tankar och väcker mina rädslor till liv igen.

key: Today a pigeon landed on our island. It brought a message which fills me with dark thoughts and brings back my fears.

source.other: Build a stonemason’s house and mining infrastructure

target.other: Bygg ett stenhuggeri och gruvinfrastruktur

key: Build a stonemason’s house and mining infrastructure

source.other: To provide these foodstuffs, you can build a fisher’s house, a hunter’s house, a farm, a mill and a bakery.

target.other: För försörjning av dessa matresurser kan du bygga en fiskarstuga, en jägarstuga, en bondgård, en väderkvarn och ett bageri.

key: To provide these foodstuffs, you can build a fisher’s house, a hunter’s house, a farm, a mill and a bakery.

source.other: Destroy the Barbarian Tribe

target.other: Förstör barbarstammen

key: Destroy the Barbarian Tribe

source.other: Start mining marble

target.other: Börja bryta marmor

key: Start mining marble

source.other: Saledus is excited

target.other: Saledus är exalterad

key: Saledus is excited

source.other: Great! Today the building of the quarry was completed. Now we will get enough granite and marble to construct larger buildings.

target.other: Strålande! I dag blev stenbrottsbyggnaden klar. Nu kommer vi att ha nog med granit och marmor för att bygga större byggnader.

key: Great! Today the building of the quarry was completed. Now we will get enough granite and marble to construct larger buildings.

source.other: Sire, I don’t want to start a panic, but I found something which gives me a sinking feeling in my stomach and spreads waves of fear in my heart. As I walked down to the southern shore, I found the remains of another ship. I don’t know whether these parts are all that is left of that ship. In any case, these parts do not seem to be old.

target.other: Vår ledare, jag vill inte skapa panik, men jag hittade någonting som ger mig en dålig känsla i magen och sprider skräck inom mig. När jag gick längs den södra stranden hittade jag resterna av ett annat skepp. Jag vet inte om dessa delar är allt som finns kvar av skeppet. Hur som helst verkar delarna inte särskilt gamla.

key: Sire, I don’t want to start a panic, but I found something which gives me a sinking feeling in my stomach and spreads waves of fear in my heart. As I walked down to the southern shore, I found the remains of another ship. I don’t know whether these parts are all that is left of that ship. In any case, these parts do not seem to be old.

source.other: Lutius, don’t you think you forgot something important?

target.other: Lutius, tycker du inte att du har glömt något viktigt?

key: Lutius, don’t you think you forgot something important?

source.other: Again, I felt like I was in paradise when I noticed that some marble-like stones were among the rocks. It seems that we will soon be able to build strong, luxurious buildings, like those we were accustomed to in Fremil.

target.other: Återigen kände jag mig som i paradiset när jag såg några marmorliknande stenar bland klipporna. Det ser ut som om vi snart kommer att kunna bygga kraftiga, eleganta byggnader, sådana som vi var vana vid i Fremil.

key: Again, I felt like I was in paradise when I noticed that some marble-like stones were among the rocks. It seems that we will soon be able to build strong, luxurious buildings, like those we were accustomed to in Fremil.

source.other: Marble on the Mountain

target.other: Marmor i berget

key: Marble on the Mountain

source.other: That’s good. The first big military building is complete and the mining infrastructure is getting better and better. Now we should think about preparing ourselves for battle.

target.other: Det är bra. Den första stora militärbyggnaden är klar och gruvinfrastrukturen blir bättre och bättre. Nu måste vi börja tänka på att förbereda oss för strid.

key: That’s good. The first big military building is complete and the mining infrastructure is getting better and better. Now we should think about preparing ourselves for battle.

source.other: After everything, we can now begin to live like we did in Fremil.

target.other: Nu kan vi, till sist, börja leva som vi gjorde i Fremil.

key: After everything, we can now begin to live like we did in Fremil.

source.other: Saledus smiles

target.other: Saledus ler

key: Saledus smiles

source.other: Quarry

target.other: Stenbrott

key: Quarry

source.other: Our New Tavern

target.other: Vår nya krog

key: Our New Tavern

source.other: The message was addressed to me, begging me to come back to Fremil. It says that the Empire is at war with the Barbarians. They were attacked from the north by the tribe that I was forbidden to attack. It is clear to me what I must do…

target.other: Meddelandet var adresserat till mig, med en vädjan att komma tillbaka till Fremil. Det säger att Imperiet är i krig med barbarerna. De attackerades från norr av stammen som jag inte fick anfalla. Det står klart för mig vad jag måste göra…

key: The message was addressed to me, begging me to come back to Fremil. It says that the Empire is at war with the Barbarians. They were attacked from the north by the tribe that I was forbidden to attack. It is clear to me what I must do…

source.other: Protect Your Eastern Frontier

target.other: Skydda den östra gränsen

key: Protect Your Eastern Frontier

source.other: Today, as I walked down to the eastern shore, I got a shock. I caught sight of one of those hated, evil, Barbarian tribes with whom we have had so many problems before.

target.other: I dag när jag gick längs östra stranden fick jag en chock. Jag fick syn på en av de hatade, ondsinta barbarstammarna som vi tidigare har haft så mycket problem med.

key: Today, as I walked down to the eastern shore, I got a shock. I caught sight of one of those hated, evil, Barbarian tribes with whom we have had so many problems before.

source.other: Build a quarry to the south of your headquarters.

target.other: Bygg ett stenbrott söder om ditt högkvarter.

key: Build a quarry to the south of your headquarters.

source.other: The Barbarians

target.other: Barbarerna

key: The Barbarians

source.other: Maybe you will also need a piggery, a vineyard and some wells.

target.other: Kanske du även behöver en grisuppfödning, en vingård och några brunnar.

key: Maybe you will also need a piggery, a vineyard and some wells.

source.other: Build some blockhouses and sentries around the colony.

target.other: Bygg några blockhus och vaktposter runt kolonin.

key: Build some blockhouses and sentries around the colony.

source.other: Later, I walked down to the rocks in the south and looked for a place where we could build a quarry to get some granite for our larger buildings.

target.other: Senare gick jag ned till klipporna i söder och letade efter en plats där vi kunde bygga ett stenbrott för att skaffa oss lite granit till våra större byggnader.

key: Later, I walked down to the rocks in the south and looked for a place where we could build a quarry to get some granite for our larger buildings.

source.other: Victory

target.other: Seger

key: Victory

source.other: Of course this means you will need more resources for preparing this food – like fish, meat or bread.

target.other: Givetvis innebär detta att du kommer att behöva mer resurser för att laga denna mat – som fisk, kött och bröd.

key: Of course this means you will need more resources for preparing this food – like fish, meat or bread.

source.other: Build a brewery and a winery to supply the miners with some good and strong drinks.

target.other: Bygg ett bryggeri och en vinjäsningsanläggning för att förse gruvarbetarna med starka och goda drycker.

key: Build a brewery and a winery to supply the miners with some good and strong drinks.

source.other: As Saledus and I walked through these wonderful forests in the north, we felt that our future had just begun. This land is so peaceful, good and beautiful, I could stay here until the end of my life.

target.other: När Saledus och jag vandrade genom dessa underbara skogar i norr kände vi att vår framtid just hade börjat. Detta land är så fredligt, gott och vackert, att jag skulle kunna stanna här tills jag dör.

key: As Saledus and I walked through these wonderful forests in the north, we felt that our future had just begun. This land is so peaceful, good and beautiful, I could stay here until the end of my life.

source.other: We have established a working economy, trained new soldiers and driven the Barbarians from the island. Now we can think about our next steps.

target.other: Vi har etablerat en fungerande ekonomi, tränat nya soldater och jagat iväg barbarerna från ön. Nu kan vi börja tänka på nästa steg.

key: We have established a working economy, trained new soldiers and driven the Barbarians from the island. Now we can think about our next steps.

source.other: Amalea enters…

target.other: Amalea kommer in…

key: Amalea enters…

source.other: Build a fortress on the peninsula (near where the Barbarian headquarters stood before). Finally, this will avoid new settlements of other tribes in that region.

target.other: Bygg en fästning på halvön (nära platsen där barbarernas högkvarter tidigare stod). Till sist hindrar detta andra stammar från att bosätta sig i området.

key: Build a fortress on the peninsula (near where the Barbarian headquarters stood before). Finally, this will avoid new settlements of other tribes in that region.

source.other: Provide your miners with food

target.other: Förse dina gruvarbetare med mat

key: Provide your miners with food

source.other: Build a quarry

target.other: Bygg ett stenbrott

key: Build a quarry

source.other: The Rocks

target.other: Klipporna

key: The Rocks

source.other: Command to Attack

target.other: Ge order om attack

key: Command to Attack

source.other: Wood Economy

target.other: Träförsörjning

key: Wood Economy

source.other: It’s nice, and of course a good idea, to build mines, which will give us a more comfortable life, but the people working in the mines are unhappy with the current situation. They have to do hard work and have no time for making their own food.

target.other: Det är trevligt, och förstås en bra idé, att bygga gruvor som kommer att ge oss ett bekvämare liv, men människorna som arbetar i gruvorna är missnöjda med den nuvarande situationen. De måste arbeta hårt och har ingen tid för att laga sin egen mat.

key: It’s nice, and of course a good idea, to build mines, which will give us a more comfortable life, but the people working in the mines are unhappy with the current situation. They have to do hard work and have no time for making their own food.

source.other: Attack and completely destroy the Barbarian buildings as soon as you have enough soldiers.

target.other: Attackera och totalförstör barbarernas byggnader så snart som du har nog med soldater.

key: Attack and completely destroy the Barbarian buildings as soon as you have enough soldiers.

source.other: Perhaps the people aboard that ship were caught in the same storm which brought us to Malac’ Mor – and were brought to this island.

target.other: Kanske fastnade deras skepp i samma storm som förde oss till Malac’ Mor – och de fördes också hit till ön.

key: Perhaps the people aboard that ship were caught in the same storm which brought us to Malac’ Mor – and were brought to this island.

source.other: Expand to the east, to start mining marble from the mountain.

target.other: Expandera österut för att börja bryta marmor ur berget.

key: Expand to the east, to start mining marble from the mountain.

source.other: By the Gods, this is an unbelievable stroke of fortune! There are two more mountains, and it seems that one has a large quantity of coal and the other of iron ore. I advise you to immediately build iron and coal mines (or at least charcoal kilns), smelting works, toolsmithies, armor and weapon smithies.

target.other: Vid gudarna, vi har en otrolig tur! Det finns ytterligare två berg och det verkar som att ett av dem innehåller mängder av kol och det andra verkar innehålla rikligt med järnmalm. Jag råder dig att omedelbart bygga järn- och kolgruvor (eller åtminstone kolmilor), smältverk, verktygssmedjor, rustnings- och vapensmedjor.

key: By the Gods, this is an unbelievable stroke of fortune! There are two more mountains, and it seems that one has a large quantity of coal and the other of iron ore. I advise you to immediately build iron and coal mines (or at least charcoal kilns), smelting works, toolsmithies, armor and weapon smithies.

source.other: Marble

target.other: Marmor

key: Marble

source.other: Protect your eastern frontier

target.other: Skydda den östra gränsen

key: Protect your eastern frontier

source.other: But we mustn’t forget to preserve this natural bounty. These forests should last forever, so we really have to build a forester’s house too.

target.other: Men vi får heller inte glömma att bevara denna naturs gåva. Dessa skogar ska vara för evigt så vi måste absolut bygga ett skogsvaktarboställe också.

key: But we mustn’t forget to preserve this natural bounty. These forests should last forever, so we really have to build a forester’s house too.

source.other: There are still a few Barbarians hiding on our island, but I am sure that we will find them soon. Every Barbarian who doesn’t attack us will be put in a boat with the other peaceful ones, and sent back to their country.

target.other: Det finns fortfarande ett fåtal barbarer som gömmer sig på vår ö, men jag är säker på att vi hittar dem snart. Varje barbar som inte attackerar oss kommer att sättas i en båt tillsammans med de andra fredliga och skickas tillbaka till sitt land.

key: There are still a few Barbarians hiding on our island, but I am sure that we will find them soon. Every Barbarian who doesn’t attack us will be put in a boat with the other peaceful ones, and sent back to their country.

source.other: Today is a proud day. We have fought for our new home and risen victorious.

target.other: Idag är en dag då vi ska vara stolta. Vi har kämpat för vårt nya hem och stigit segrande ur striden.

key: Today is a proud day. We have fought for our new home and risen victorious.

source.other: As Time is Running By

target.other: Tiden går

key: As Time is Running By

source.other: Food For Your Miners

target.other: Mat åt dina gruvarbetare

key: Food For Your Miners

source.other: Stones for the Colony

target.other: Sten till kolonin

key: Stones for the Colony

source.other: Please, expand to that mountain and start mining marble.

target.other: Expandera territoriet till berget och börja bryta marmor.

key: Please, expand to that mountain and start mining marble.

source.other: Amalea smiles

target.other: Amalea ler

key: Amalea smiles

source.other: The Green Forests

target.other: De gröna skogarna

key: The Green Forests

source.other: It’s up to you what you want to build. But remember – coal and iron mines need beer, marble and gold mines need wine and all mines need at least rations, which are produced out of bread OR meat OR fish.

target.other: Det är upp till dig vad du vill bygga, men kom ihåg: kol- och järngruvor behöver öl, marmor- och guldgruvor behöver vin och alla gruvor behöver åtminstone matportioner, vilka produceras av bröd, kött eller fisk.

key: It’s up to you what you want to build. But remember – coal and iron mines need beer, marble and gold mines need wine and all mines need at least rations, which are produced out of bread OR meat OR fish.

source.other: At first, I was naive and hoped that they were peaceful, but as soon as one of them saw me, they charged towards me and started attacking me with their throwing spears. Thanks be to the Gods that I was able to flee and hide myself, before retreating back to our colony under cover of darkness.

target.other: Till en början var jag naiv och hoppades att de var fredliga, men så snart en av dem såg mig rusade de mot mig och började attackera mig med sina kastspjut. Tacka gudarna att jag kunde fly och gömma mig, för att senare ta mig tillbaka hit under skydd av mörkret.

key: At first, I was naive and hoped that they were peaceful, but as soon as one of them saw me, they charged towards me and started attacking me with their throwing spears. Thanks be to the Gods that I was able to flee and hide myself, before retreating back to our colony under cover of darkness.

source.other: You have completed this mission. You may continue playing if you wish, otherwise move on to the next mission.

target.other: Du har slutfört det här uppdraget. Du kan fortsätta spela om du vill. Annars går du vidare till nästa uppdrag.

key: You have completed this mission. You may continue playing if you wish, otherwise move on to the next mission.

source.other: I just visited our new tavern ‘At the palms’. The beer they serve is really tasty. You really should have a drink there, too.

target.other: Jag besökte just vår nya krog 'Vattenhålet vid palmerna'. Ölen de serverar är verkligen god. Du borde också ta dig ett glas där.

key: I just visited our new tavern ‘At the palms’. The beer they serve is really tasty. You really should have a drink there, too.

source.other: Destroy the Barbarian tribe

target.other: Förstör barbarstammen

key: Destroy the Barbarian tribe

source.other: A New Island

target.other: En ny ö

key: A New Island

source.other: Build a barracks to start training soldiers.

target.other: Bygg en militärförläggning för att börja träna soldater.

key: Build a barracks to start training soldiers.

source.other: Good news! Today our wood economy was completed. Now we can be sure that we will have enough wood for our future building projects.

target.other: Goda nyheter! I dag blev vår träförsörjning klar. Nu kan vi vara säkra på att ha nog med trä för våra framtida byggnadsprojekt.

key: Good news! Today our wood economy was completed. Now we can be sure that we will have enough wood for our future building projects.

source.other: Anyway, we must build stronger military buildings as soon as possible.

target.other: Hur som helst måste vi bygga starkare militärbyggnader så snart som möjligt.

key: Anyway, we must build stronger military buildings as soon as possible.

source.other: By the Gods! This is absolutely terrible. It seems as if we stand close to a test – and it seems as if Saledus was right with his fear concerning the shipwreck he found.

target.other: Vid gudarna! Detta är helt förfärligt. Det verkar som om vi står inför en prövning – och det ser ut som om Saledus hade rätt i sin rädsla när han hittade skeppsvraket.

key: By the Gods! This is absolutely terrible. It seems as if we stand close to a test – and it seems as if Saledus was right with his fear concerning the shipwreck he found.

source.other: Dangerous Ship Parts

target.other: Farliga skeppsdelar

key: Dangerous Ship Parts

source.other: Build up a wood economy

target.other: Bygg upp en träförsörjning

key: Build up a wood economy

source.other: What do you think about helping them out? I can’t tell you what we need exactly… but here are my recommendations:

target.other: Vad tror du om att hjälpa dem? Jag kan inte säga exakt vad vi behöver … men här är mina rekommendationer:

key: What do you think about helping them out? I can’t tell you what we need exactly… but here are my recommendations:

source.other: Build a tower to watch deep inside the enemy territory.

target.other: Bygg ett torn för att se långt in i fiendens territorium.

key: Build a tower to watch deep inside the enemy territory.

source.other: It would be a good source for bolstering our supply of quality marble, beyond the meager quantities available from the quarry. Perhaps you were right when you said that this island was like paradise.

target.other: Det skulle vara en bra källa för att stärka vår tillgång till marmor av god kvalitet, utöver de ynkliga mängder vi får från stenbrottet. Kanske hade du rätt när du sa att den här ön är som ett paradis.

key: It would be a good source for bolstering our supply of quality marble, beyond the meager quantities available from the quarry. Perhaps you were right when you said that this island was like paradise.

source.other: Sire, I’ve got good news for you: As I walked to the east, I found a larger mountain. I am not absolutely sure – a geologist should check if I am right – but I believe we could mine marble from some places on the mountain.

target.other: Ledare, jag har goda nyheter till dig: När jag gick österut hittade jag ett stort berg. Jag är inte helt säker – en geolog borde kontrollera om jag har rätt – men jag tror att vi kan bryta marmor på några platser på berget.

key: Sire, I’ve got good news for you: As I walked to the east, I found a larger mountain. I am not absolutely sure – a geologist should check if I am right – but I believe we could mine marble from some places on the mountain.
